review.reason: The mapped layout, hazards, greens, and walking connectors are generally preserved, and the greens read as continuous putting surfaces. However, trees crowd and obstruct the T3-to-Hole 3 first-landing corridor.

issues.detail: Tree crowns between T3 and the start of Hole 3’s fairway obstruct the broad tee-to-landing corridor.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the intended carry appear tree-blocked and obscures the clear route from T3 to its first fairway landing area.
